profile.name: FOUAD AL-SHAMI
profile.headline: I build what works behind the scenes.
profile.intro: Computer Systems Engineering student | Gaza, Palestine
profile.about:
I’m a Computer Systems Engineering student at Al-Azhar University – Gaza, focused on backend development. I enjoy understanding how a product should work, structuring its data and connecting the services behind it.

Through RIVO, I have worked on a digital storefront with customer accounts, catalog management, orders and supplier integrations. In Athar, my technical role starts with local needs and requirements, and continues into platform development. My graduation project, Vaxora, is currently focused on analyzing a digital child vaccination record for the realities families face in Gaza.

I value practical systems, clear responsibilities and collaboration. I’m continuing to develop my engineering skills through projects and team experience.
profile.overview: I’m Fouad, a Computer Systems Engineering student at Al-Azhar University – Gaza. I build backend services and web products, with hands-on work across digital commerce, community platforms and requirements analysis. My projects connect software decisions with the people and workflows they need to support.
profile.focus: Backend services · API integrations · Data modeling · Requirements analysis

projects.name: RIVO
projects.detail: A digital commerce project for game cards and top-ups, combining the customer storefront with an operations dashboard.
projects.stack: JavaScript · Cloudflare Workers · D1 · R2 · API Integration · Authentication
projects.role: Developed the store and administration workflows: customer accounts, product/category management, orders, supplier configuration and payment integration.
projects.challenge: Bring digital products, supplier data and customer orders into one manageable storefront.
projects.solution: A customer storefront connected to account and order services, with an admin dashboard for catalog and operational tasks. Supplier data is mapped into the store, and payment notifications update the order workflow.
projects.decisions: Cloudflare Workers runs the application, D1 stores structured data and R2 handles file storage. Supplier identifiers and USD prices support catalog mapping and margin calculations. Payment integration includes a signed webhook to verify incoming notifications.
projects.flow: Customer storefront → Worker services → D1 records / supplier & payment integrations

projects.name: ATHAR
projects.detail: Helping small businesses in Gaza build a digital presence.
projects.stack: Requirements Analysis · Platform planning · Content workflows
projects.role: Technical responsibility for needs analysis, requirements and platform development, in coordination with the Athar Youth Team.
projects.challenge: Small and home businesses need a clearer way to present their work and reach people in their community.
projects.solution: An Arabic-first business directory with stable project pages, search and filtering, direct contact links, owner updates and admin content review. The initial initiative focuses on 30 businesses, with a scope that can later expand across Gaza.
projects.result: In progress. Requirements and the platform experience are being developed for the initiative’s initial group of 30 businesses.
projects.decisions: The platform acts as a discovery and contact intermediary. Owners manage business content, with changes reviewed by an administrator. The planned assistant has a daily usage limit.
projects.flow: Visitor discovery → Business profile → Direct contact | Owner updates → Admin review

projects.name: VAXORA
projects.detail: A graduation project for a digital child vaccination record.
projects.stack: Requirements Analysis · Healthcare workflows · Offline requirements
projects.role: Member of a four-student graduation project team, working on the problem definition, analysis and requirements documentation.
projects.challenge: Paper vaccination records can be lost during displacement, making follow-up harder for families.
projects.solution: A digital child vaccination record where centers document administered doses and health professionals set the next appointment. Families can follow separate read-only records for multiple children, receive reminders and view saved information offline.
projects.result: Analysis and requirements documentation. It is not yet a deployed or clinically validated service.
projects.decisions: Vaccination confirmation belongs to the administering center. Appointment dates are set by professionals. Basic vaccinations have reminders; additional doses can be displayed without that reminder schedule.
projects.flow: Center registration → Verified vaccination record → Family read-only view & appointment reminders
